articles.summary: AI agents can only act on records they can trust, and in much of finance those records still live in documents that have to be structured before automation can follow. | Pulse AI
articles.title: Agentic Workflows in Finance Depend on the Record Underneath Them

articles.summary: Private credit and syndicated loans are still run through credit agreements, agent notices and borrower reporting that teams read and key in by hand, and AI agents can only test covenants, book notices or process amendments once those documents have been turned into structured, traceable data they can rely on. | Pulse AI
articles.title: Loan Operations Still Run on Documents, and Agents Will Have to Read Them First
